checks.name: California Penal Code coverage is a small fraction of the code
checks.detail: 4 section(s) carry repository records, against roughly 1300 operative Penal Code sections — about 0.3%. Covered: PEN 25., PEN 26., PEN 27., PEN 459.. Every other section returns UNKNOWN, which is correct behaviour but is not coverage.

checks.name: CALCRIM coverage is a small fraction of the instruction set
checks.detail: 1 instruction link(s) against roughly 800 published CALCRIM instructions — about 0.13%. A charged offence outside this set is reported as UNKNOWN rather than analysed.

checks.name: The legal knowledge repositories are a demonstration corpus, not a working library
checks.detail: 81 records across 10 repositories, covering 4 statute section(s). The retrieval, citation and traceability machinery around them is built and certified; what is missing is the law itself. Populating it is a content acquisition exercise, not an engineering one.
